company.name: Asia Market
company.distributes: Over 6,000 Asian food products including snacks and confectionery, fresh, frozen and dried goods.
company.channels_supplied: Restaurants, takeaways, caterers and retailers in all 26 counties from a Ballymount cash and carry, with 19 delivery vehicles; also its own stores.
company.fit_rationale: The leading Asian cash and carry in Dublin with a strong trade delivery fleet. Fit is niche, since its buyers look for Asian lines, but its retail trade customers stock imported snacks.

company.name: Barry Group
company.distributes: Ambient, chilled and alcohol wholesale distribution to independent retailers.
company.channels_supplied: Costcutter, Carry Out and Quik Pick stores, plus key accounts reported as Woodies, Mr Price, Applegreen and Dairygold.
company.fit_rationale: A national delivered wholesaler with about 240 symbol stores and turnover of about 261 million euro. Coverage is reported as nationwide, but the number of Dublin stores was not confirmed.

company.name: BR Marketing
company.distributes: Multi-channel distributor of 40+ food, confectionery, sports nutrition and healthcare brands.
company.channels_supplied: Grocery, convenience, foodservice and healthcare channels.
company.sf_brands_carried: Optimum Nutrition and HalibOrange; confectionery is Swizzels. No sugar-free confectionery brand.
company.fit_rationale: Based on the Dublin and Meath border and positioned as a value-adding distributor across grocery and healthcare. Swizzels gives it confectionery buyers and the healthcare channel suits a sugar-free range.

company.name: Chemist Warehouse Ireland
company.distributes: Discount pharmacy, vitamins, health foods and beauty.
company.channels_supplied: 16 to 18 large-format stores in Dublin, Cork, Limerick, Meath, Louth and other counties, with five more planned for 2026.
company.fit_rationale: Fast-growing discount pharmacy with 18 stores since entering in 2020 and a model that carries diet and health snack lines in other markets. Irish confectionery range and local head office city were not verified.

company.name: Conaty Catering
company.distributes: Catering wholesale: ambient, chilled and frozen foods, beverages, packaging, tableware and hygiene supplies.
company.channels_supplied: Restaurants, cafes, hotels, bars and caterers, with delivery Monday to Saturday and no minimum order.
company.fit_rationale: A Stonehouse member focused on foodservice. Relevant mainly for syrups and spreads to cafes; its location and its Dublin delivery area were not confirmed in the sources checked.

company.name: Eirespan Distribution
company.distributes: Imported continental food products, private label development and food services for the FMCG sector.
company.channels_supplied: More than 2,000 customers in Ireland with some UK reach; channels not specified.
company.fit_rationale: East Wall importer of continental European products with about 1,000 lines. An importer of European goods fits Diablo's Czech-warehoused range, but brands and channels could not be confirmed from its own site.

company.name: Evergreen Healthfoods
company.distributes: Health foods, chocolate, supplements, natural bodycare.
company.channels_supplied: Eight Galway stores and a national online shop that delivers to Dublin.
company.sf_brands_carried: Runs a dedicated Sugar Free Chocolate category; brands seen include Vivani, Booja Booja, Ombar and Chocolate and Love.
company.fit_rationale: One of the largest Irish online health retailers, with a named sugar-free chocolate category that Diablo could fill with a wider range. It serves Dublin online only, so it is a national e-commerce listing more than a Dublin store listing.

company.name: Fitzpatrick Wholesale
company.distributes: Trade-only variety wholesale: toys, stationery, household, health and beauty, fancy goods and a food and drink category.
company.channels_supplied: Independent retailers, gift and variety shops across Ireland from its Bluebell, Dublin 12 cash and carry and online shop.
company.fit_rationale: A trade-only volume supplier in Dublin 12 whose listing includes food and drink. The depth of its confectionery range was not confirmed, so treat it as a seasonal and gifting opportunity.

company.name: Lidl Ireland
company.distributes: Discount grocery, mostly own label with selected brands and limited-time lines.
company.channels_supplied: 234 stores on the island of Ireland (about 173 in the Republic).
company.fit_rationale: Large estate, but range is mostly own label and the Kickstart supplier programme is aimed at local small producers. Realistic only as a limited-time themed week or a private label conversation. Head office city is my understanding.

company.name: Lynas Foodservice
company.distributes: Foodservice wholesale of over 5,000 frozen, chilled, ambient and non-food products.
company.channels_supplied: Over 5,000 foodservice customers across Northern Ireland, Ireland and Scotland.
company.fit_rationale: A family foodservice wholesaler that states it serves the Republic of Ireland. No Dublin depot was confirmed and snacks are not a stated focus, so this is a conditional lead.

company.name: Mortons
company.distributes: Fine food grocery, hampers and gift boxes, catering, wine.
company.channels_supplied: Two stores in Dublin (Ranelagh and Hatch Street) and an online shop.
company.fit_rationale: Two-store premium grocer in affluent south Dublin with a hamper business. Small volume, suited to gift boxes and premium bars only.

company.name: Primeline Group
company.distributes: Route to market, sales and logistics for Irish and international FMCG brands.
company.channels_supplied: Over 7,500 retailers served weekly across Ireland.
company.fit_rationale: Large route to market group just north of Dublin with a ten year Tayto distribution agreement. Much of its work is logistics for brand owners, so confirm it would buy and sell the range rather than only deliver it.

company.name: Stafford Lynch
company.distributes: Food, non-food and medicinal agency brands with a 7,000 pallet logistics centre.
company.channels_supplied: Multiples, convenience, foodservice, pharmacy, discounters, health stores and online; about 3,000 retail touchpoints across the island.
company.sf_brands_carried: Canderel sweetener and LoSalt; no sugar-free confectionery brand.
company.fit_rationale: Dublin 15 distributor that already sells Canderel into grocery, pharmacy and health stores, so the sugar-reduction buyer conversations exist. No confectionery in the portfolio, which means no conflict but also less category weight.
